{{Quote|There's enough scrap metal in this guy to build two battle droids and still have some left over for spare parts.|Jos Vondar commenting on the amount of shrapnel in the clone trooper|<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons" />}}
A '''clone trooper''' [[Cloning/Legends|cloned]] from the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]], served in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] fought between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]], the clone trooper was wounded by shrapnel during a [[Battle of Drongar|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Drongar/Legends|Drongar]] while in the [[Poptree Forest]]. He was taken to [[Republic Mobile Surgical Unit 7]] where the [[Doctor/Legends|surgeon]], [[Jos Vondar]], operated on his wounds.<ref name="MedStar I: Battle Surgeons" />
